items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: we had a fellow struggling around there - a fellow named Lionel.

ctx.x: They couldn't do nothing. But they were hooked wrong, you see? And, I know in the Army once ~~Strug~~ gling -- we had a fellow struggling around there - a fellow named Lionel. He was struggling around there with trying to play trombone. Wasn't going no place. He was a pianist, had been a church organist, you see. And they had switched him --

Bill Vodery had switched him to the saxophone, and in four or five days, he was playing the saxophone. And he was fooling around there with the trombone. I mean, you can get there in the wrong place, you know what I mean?
